# Supabase browser SDK

`supabase-2.118.0.js` is the unmodified UMD browser build from the official
`@supabase/supabase-js@2.118.0` npm package. Its MIT license is in
`supabase-LICENSE`.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/@supabase/supabase-js/-/supabase-js-2.118.0.tgz

The package was verified against its published SHA-512 integrity value:

```text
sha512-FxI8UXMVC2UG7IkeiI8fuQZqq2oI3JeSuN8MPIC2RLVaoEAxKS0nqE6kii9Ewpq8f9gNPM6git1Y8f0vN/QLFw==
```

The SDK is hosted with the site so sign-in does not fetch executable JavaScript
from a third-party CDN. Updates should remain pinned and retain this license.
